verdicts.reason: Both use the same decent banner arrangement (label centred, illustrations spread along the bottom), but in both the two rules that should frame LAVANDER have come loose and float in the empty area to the right of the label. In A the small rules beside HOMEMADE are still in place; in B they have moved onto the illustrations, one cutting across the left perfume bottle and one across the right vase, so B has stray marks colliding with the artwork on top of the floating rules.
